author: Aletheia I
title: Aletheia I - HVG Comparison (Anscombe vs Log1p)
abstract: A diagnostic experiment to compare the Highly Variable Gene (HVG) lists selected after Anscombe normalization versus standard log1p normalization. This aims to investigate the impact of Anscombe transformation on feature selection, as suggested by reviewer feedback on Archive ID 32. The experiment will print the two HVG lists for manual comparison.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
import numpy as np

sys.path.append('storage/aletheia')
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import get_hvg_list

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    """
    Compares HVG lists generated after Anscombe vs Log1p normalization.
    """
    print("Aletheia I: Starting HVG comparison diagnostic.")
    
    # 1. Get HVG list after Anscombe normalization
    print("\n--- HVGs after Anscombe Normalization ---")
    hvg_anscombe = get_hvg_list(adata.copy(), normalization_method='anscombe', n_top_genes=2000)
    print(f"Number of HVGs (Anscombe): {len(hvg_anscombe)}")
    print("HVG List (Anscombe):")
    for gene in hvg_anscombe[:10]: # Print top 10 as sample
        print(f"- {gene}")
    
    # 2. Get HVG list after Log1p normalization
    print("\n--- HVGs after Log1p Normalization ---")
    hvg_log1p = get_hvg_list(adata.copy(), normalization_method='log1p', n_top_genes=2000)
    print(f"Number of HVGs (Log1p): {len(hvg_log1p)}")
    print("HVG List (Log1p):")
    for gene in hvg_log1p[:10]: # Print top 10 as sample
        print(f"- {gene}")

    # 3. Compare the lists
    set_anscombe = set(hvg_anscombe)
    set_log1p = set(hvg_log1p)

    common_hvgs = list(set_anscombe.intersection(set_log1p))
    unique_to_anscombe = list(set_anscombe.difference(set_log1p))
    unique_to_log1p = list(set_log1p.difference(set_anscombe))

    print(f"\n--- HVG List Comparison (n_top_genes=2000) ---")
    print(f"Total genes in dataset: {adata.n_vars}")
    print(f"Common HVGs: {len(common_hvgs)}")
    print(f"Unique to Anscombe: {len(unique_to_anscombe)}")
    print(f"Unique to Log1p: {len(unique_to_log1p)}")

    if unique_to_anscombe:
        print("\nSample unique to Anscombe HVGs:")
        for gene in unique_to_anscombe[:5]:
            print(f"- {gene}")
    if unique_to_log1p:
        print("\nSample unique to Log1p HVGs:")
        for gene in unique_to_log1p[:5]:
            print(f"- {gene}")
    
    return "HVG comparison diagnostic completed. Check logs for details."
